scopeNote: No confidently demonstrated incorrect canonical answer was found in the 310 linked stem/key/explanation comparisons. The following are original coverage additions, not permission to import old source demonstrations, not native/domain signoff, and not silently hash-bind old translations.

coverageAdditions.proposedAppendJa: 別の練習では、売上240万円、原価72万円、労働分配率40％、総実働400時間とする。粗利益は168万円、人件費は67万2千円である。一人一時間当たりに換算すると、売上6,000円、原価1,800円、粗利益4,200円、人件費1,680円となる。40％を掛ける相手は売上ではなく粗利益であり、人時生産性4,200円に40％を掛けても1,680円になる。
coverageAdditions.remainingAfterAppend: Head-office/CK cost allocation, full-company versus store labor-distribution explanations and a new independently drawn ratio diagram still need authoring; this single append does not close every listed unit.

coverageAdditions.proposedAppendJa: 参照教材には率の差を±0.5の範囲と比べる例がある。これはその教材で用いた管理上の基準例であり、すべての店に共通する法律上の許容値ではない。割合を百分率で表示した二つの値の差はパーセントポイントで扱い、自店の定義、比較期間、判断基準を明記する。
coverageAdditions.remainingAfterAppend: Root should confirm the source's inconsistent percent/ratio notation and preserve the current explicit subtraction-order treatment; do not reintroduce its ambiguous 逆ざや label.

coverageAdditions.proposedAppendJa: 客単価を詳しく見ると、一人が注文する平均点数と、一品当たりの平均価格の積に分けられる。例えば平均2.5品を一品平均480円で注文すると客単価は1,200円である。客が望む追加の一品を紹介する場合も、高い品への押し替えだけを成功とせず、満足、粗利益、調理負荷を合わせて確認する。

coverageAdditions.requiredArtifact: Create an original filled/blank sales-to-recipes-to-ingredients table plus ordering/delivery calendar; include lead time, supplier holidays, usable current stock, accepted incoming stock and storage/expiry limits.
coverageAdditions.safetyAndOriginalityNote: Do not copy the source table or its 120/110 percent assumptions as a universal stock rule. Use a new scenario with explicit assumptions.

coverageAdditions.proposedAppendJa: 面接では履歴書と所定の記入票を確認し、業務に必要な本人確認資料を適切に扱う。希望職種と勤務可能な時間を尋ね、出退勤や勤務中の基本ルールを説明して認識をそろえる。採否を判断する担当と承認先を確かめ、必要な了承が済む前に採用確定の約束をしない。個人情報は採用目的に必要な範囲で管理する。
coverageAdditions.remainingAfterAppend: Identity-document selection and recruitment privacy/current law require separate qualified review; no excessive or irrelevant applicant data collection is authorized.

coverageAdditions.requiredWork: Verify current authoritative fire rules for the building/use before authoring exact drill cadence. Add an original routine checklist for dead spaces/combustibles, nonpublic unused-room access, authorized personnel identification, surveillance/patrol arrangements and interior fire-performance conditions without obstructing emergency exits.
mustNotRestore: Cloth over burning fryer as unqualified general instruction
Returning for possessions/documents or delaying customer evacuation

coverageAdditions.requiredArtifact: Independently authored observation cards for the complete Q/S/C/A check categories; greeting/standing/passing/bowing practice; and all six routine service priorities, with emergency safety overriding the routine list. Distinguish omissions in teaching from questions that already exercise the concept.

Original numbered cleaning procedure cards (mop motion, window tool/rinse/squeegee/frame, condiment container empty/wash/rinse/drain/refill, device-safe wiping, toilet separation) and an original complaint flow from apology/listening to manager solution, thanks and final report. Source multipliers and patrol frequencies are examples, not cross-product rules.

Original anatomical/direction guide and supervised practical sequence distinguishing tail-to-head scaling, gill attachments, fillet versus whole-fish internal-organ incisions and the fin/spine landmarks for head removal. Preserve knife safety, contamination separation and qualification-specific exclusions. A generic fish silhouette alone will not close these units.

coverageAdditions.requiredWork: Create original machine-by-machine inspection cards, distinguishing hot/cold/washing equipment, measuring/calibration, knife materials and cleaning. Historical fryer AV, griddle temperature-spread, noodle-boiler and washer temperature examples require manufacturer/current-source scope; do not turn them into a universal machine setting or prompt tasting suspect food.
